subject: Problem with reading missing (negative) values from tps file

messages.author: 5b4b413851d6a7a8
messages.subject: Problem with reading missing (negative) values from tps file
parts:
Hi everyone,
I have a problem when I try to estimate missing landmarks. First, I loaded a tps file using readland.tps, specifying that I want negative/missing values to be read as "NA" (negNA = TRUE). Afterwards, I unsuccessfully used estimate.missing function with the next warning: 
Error in estimate.missing(A = data, method = "TPS") : No missing data.
When I looked at my data I saw that negative values were not read as "NA". Here is my code and an example of landmark configuration after using readland.tps so you can see the remaining negative values. I hope someone knows the answer to this error.
Mihajlo

CODE:
library(geomorph)
choose.files()
data <- readland.tps(file = "C:\\Users\\Mihajlo\\Documents\\Urva auropunctata\\Mandible\\6_Mandible slike\\Mandibula FixLM adults no teeth plus canine COMPLETE1.tps", specID = "ID", negNA = TRUE, warnmsg = TRUE)
estimate.missing(A = data, method = "TPS")
